targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle_states WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(duration_min)::numeric/60, 1), 0) FROM vehicle_states WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND state = 'driving' AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(duration_min)::numeric/60, 1), 0) FROM vehicle_states WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND state = 'charging' AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(duration_min)::numeric/60, 1), 0) FROM vehicle_states WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND state = 'asleep' AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
SELECT state, ROUND(SUM(duration_min)/60) AS hours FROM vehicle_states WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(start_date) GROUP BY state ORDER BY hours DESC

SELECT date_trunc('day', start_date) AS time, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN state='driving' THEN duration_min ELSE 0 END)/60) AS driving, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN state='charging' THEN duration_min ELSE 0 END)/60) AS charging, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN state='asleep' THEN duration_min ELSE 0 END)/60) AS asleep, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN state='online' THEN duration_min ELSE 0 END)/60) AS online, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN state='offline' THEN duration_min ELSE 0 END)/60) AS offline FROM vehicle_states WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(start_date) GROUP BY date_trunc('day', start_date) ORDER BY time
SELECT state, start_date, end_date, ROUND(duration_min::numeric, 1) AS duration_min FROM vehicle_states WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(start_date) ORDER BY start_date DESC LIMIT 100

list.name: vehicle_id
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, COALESCE(display_name, vin) AS __text FROM vehicles ORDER BY id
